name: Palladous-Hamada
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in a nearby asteroid belt. Travelers navigate by an ancient meteor crater and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.

Breathable air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything. Forests of black-leaved flora drink the dim light and exhale a scent like cold iron.
Debris from the starship crash site (colony ship) rings the crash basin in a perfect fan, which ballistics cannot explain. Survivors' accounts disagree about the last hour completely.
For traders, iron, platinum and solar potential alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
